title: flywheel: orch_review input
description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_review instead; removed in v4.0] Submit bead implementation for review. action=hit-me spawns parallel review agents (returns agent task specs for Claude Code to spawn). action=looks-good marks bead done and advances. action=skip defers the bead. action=report completes a headless review with a CI exit signal. Use beadId=__gates__ for guided review gates after all beads are done. mode dispatches the same reviewers into four shapes (interactive/autofix/report-only/headless) per bead agent-flywheel-plugin-f0j.

beadId.description: The bead being reviewed (from br list), or '__gates__' for guided review gates, or '__regress_to_plan__'/'__regress_to_beads__'/'__regress_to_implement__' for phase regression

action.description: hit-me=spawn parallel review agents, looks-good=mark done and advance, skip=defer bead, report=submit an aggregated headless result, converge=record one fresh-eyes round (converges after 2 clean rounds in a row or 5 rounds), cross-agent=build a peer-review prompt for a model family other than the implementer's

mode.description: Review-mode matrix. autofix=reviewers apply diffs + commit (gated behind green doctor + clean tree); report-only=reviewers write docs/reviews/<date>.md and exit; headless=CI-friendly exit-code signal per error count; interactive=AskUserQuestion per finding (default).

parallelSafe.description: Caller asserts reviewers can run in parallel without racing on the same files. Advisory flag only — does not disable the autofix gate.

findingCount.description: Aggregated number of findings. Required when action=report and mode=headless; the round's finding count for action=converge (default 0).

rejectedReason.description: For action=cross-agent: why an earlier review rejected the bead. Adds it to the prompt and returns a selfAnnealingRule draft for flywheel_memory.

crashed.description: Set true when at least one headless reviewer crashed. Used only with action=report.
